tools.name: list_study_destinations
tools.title: List study destinations
tools.description: List all 18 Maxim Study World study destinations with region, tagline and popular fields of study. Optionally fetch the full guide for one destination by slug.

slug.description: Destination slug such as 'australia' or 'uk'. Omit to list all destinations.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List Maxim Study World's services (free counselling, university admission, scholarship guidance, student visa filing, IELTS/English support, pre-departure briefing) with the steps included in each.

slug.description: Service slug such as 'admission-support' or 'visa-services'. Omit to list all services.

tools.name: list_reels
tools.title: List Facebook reels
tools.description: List the official Maxim Study World Facebook reels embedded on the site, with their Facebook URLs and the page they appear on.

tools.name: get_company_and_contact
tools.title: Get company info and contact details
tools.description: Get Maxim Study World's verified contact details — Khilgaon (Dhaka) office address, phone numbers, email, opening hours, social profiles, Google Maps link, company stats and FAQs.
